description: Socket tests failed with 'path too long' because macOS caps Unix socket paths at 104 bytes and $TMPDIR/scratchpad paths exceed it
resolution: Use a short dir like /tmp/fk.XXXX or temp_dir()/flk-<pid>-x for test sockets

content: Never give a module the id 'reload' or 'events': app::control handles reload before the registry and the socket server handles events, so the module would be unreachable

title: Event subscribers detect hang-up via a blocking reader + writer thread joined...
rationale: Event subscribers detect hang-up via a blocking reader + writer thread joined through Hub::unsubscribe; never poll or use read timeouts, because idle CPU must stay ~0

title: Control replies are parsed as JSON only when the request ends in --json (core...
rationale: Control replies are parsed as JSON only when the request ends in --json (core::control::split_json); otherwise clip get of JSON-looking text would change shape and break the text client.

description: A newly added module verb fails with 'unknown command' from ./target/debug/flick: 'flick <module> <verb>' goes over the control socket to the already-running Flick (old build).
resolution: Rebuild and restart the running Flick before using a new verb; verify the verb through module tests (run_verb) meanwhile.

description: run::exec wrote stdin synchronously before its budget loop; a child that stops reading more than the 64 KB pipe buffer blocked forever with no kill.
resolution: run::exec_bytes writes stdin on its own thread (PR #38).
